dish.note: Wobbly vanilla custard between crisp pastry, passionfruit icing.
dish.how: Bake 2 sheets of puff pastry (pricked, between trays) at 200C for 25 minutes until flat and golden. Whisk 750ml milk, 120g sugar, 60g cornflour, 3 egg yolks and 2 tsp vanilla in a pot over medium heat for 8 minutes until thick, stir in 30g butter and cool for 20 minutes. Spread the custard over one pastry sheet, top with the other and ice with 1 cup icing sugar mixed with the pulp of 2 passionfruit and a little water. Chill 30 minutes and cut into 4 big squares.

steps.text: Prick the pastry sheets, bake between two trays at 200C until flat and golden, then cool.
Cook the milk, sugar, cornflour, yolks and vanilla over medium heat, whisking, until thick. Stir in the butter.
Cool the custard, spread over one pastry sheet and top with the second.
Mix the icing sugar with passionfruit pulp and spread over the top.
Chill, then cut into 4 squares with a serrated knife.

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before and chill; ice just before serving
